goal: Explicitly restrict CI workflow token permissions to read-only repository contents access
Prevent workflow jobs from inheriting broader default token privileges in contributor forks
agreement: Support for hardening CI by dropping unneeded token privileges and making permissions explicit (real-or-random)
Questioned practical value since the main repo is already read-only and fork settings are out of scope (hebasto)
Suggested documentation references and keeping workflow yaml minimal, which the author addressed (maflcko)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it hardens CI workflows by making minimal read permissions explicit in repository configuration
The practical impact is minor because the repository already defaults CI tokens to read-only

categories.name: tests
why: P4 because it only adjusts CI workflow token privileges rather than test logic or test harness behavior
It has no impact on test execution, test coverage, or test framework reliability
